title: Private Deployment: Security Launch Runbook (RBAC, Audit Logs, KMS)
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Summary:
This ticket coordinates the product launch for Private/VPC/on-prem security features needed for regulated customers: fine-grained RBAC, tenant-scoped audit logging (immutable stream to S3/GCS), and KMS-backed encryption key management integration (AWS KMS / GCP KMS / customer HSM via KMIP). Goal is a coordinated cross-functional release that meets SOC2/ISO requirements and enables sales enablement and tenant onboarding playbooks.

Scope (In):
- RBAC: role definitions (admin, developer, viewer, auditor), API + Console enforcement, provisioning API for IdP provisioning sync (SCIM stub).
- Audit Logs: write-ahead immutable event stream, retention configuration, secure export to customer-managed buckets, access control to audit objects.
- KMS: support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and GCP KMS; provide HSM/KMIP integration alpha for on-prem customers.

Out of scope:
- Full SCIM provisioning implementation (only idempotent SCIM mapping contract provided in v1).
- SIEM connectors beyond S3/GCS export (will be future work).

Success metrics:
- 3 pilot customers onboarded by EOW launch + 5 customers in pipeline with signed contracts mentioning Private security.
- Zero P0 security incidents in 30 days post-launch.
- <2% increase in average API latency for authenticated Private requests.

Release Notes (customer-facing draft):
Redwood Private: Enhanced security for Private deployments — including role-based access controls, tamper-evident audit logs exportable to your cloud storage, and customer-managed key support for data-at-rest. These features enable compliance with audit and data residency requirements and integrate with common cloud KMS providers. See the Private deployment docs and migration guide for configuration steps and example policies.

  - Legal review for data processing addendum and export controls. (Legal: D. Liu)
  - Draft customer-facing release notes and migration FAQ. (Docs: Priya Shah)
- Launch day (Marketing / Sales / Support):

  - Enable dedicated playbook in Salesforce and update pricing SKU for Dedicated Private Security Add-on. (RevOps: J. Patel)
  - Run internal enablement session and record training for Support/SEs. (PM/SE: Marcus)
- Post-launch (Ops / Eng / PM):
  - Monitor audit ingestion pipeline and storage costs for first 14 days. (Ops: A. Kim)
  - Collect pilot customer feedback and triage regressions. (PM: Avery)
  - Plan roadmap items for SCIM provisioning and SIEM connectors. (PM/Eng)

Dependencies and blocking items:
- ENG-2890: KMS integration core SDK (blocking KMS alpha).
- ENG-3152: Audit pipeline durability fixes (must be complete before export).
- ENG-3247: RBAC enforcement at API gateway (security-critical).
- Security Review Board sign-off (blocking GA).

Risk assessment and mitigations:
- Risk: Misconfigured audit exports could leak data. Mitigation: default to encrypted customer-managed buckets, require confirmation checkbox in Console, and automatic dry-run validation during onboarding.
- Risk: Key rotation edge-cases causing downtime. Mitigation: implement zero-downtime key rollover and staged rotation in staging with pilot customers.
- Risk: Support bounce due to permission model complexity. Mitigation: publish role mapping quickstart templates and include SE walkthroughs.

Draft customer migration note (short):
If you're using Redwood Private, enable "Audit export" and point it to your S3/GCS bucket. For customer-managed encryption, provide an ARN/key id from your KMS provider and follow the CLI steps to validate permissions. Contact your customer success manager to do a guided onboarding and test export validation.
